headline: Iran's Parsian Operational Zone Reaches 65 MCM Daily Gas Output
summary: Iran is producing 65 million cubic meters of natural gas daily from four fields in its Parsian Operational Zone following maintenance and field stabilization operations.
why: Parsian is an essential upstream production complex supplying Iran's domestic gas grid and processing infrastructure.

impacts.name: Iranian Natural Gas
impacts.why: Field stabilization supports natural gas throughput of 65 million cubic meters per day.
